name: s2k_FrameDistributedLoad
formula: =LAMBDA(LoadPat,Dir,Frames,Value,[isGlobalCoor],LET(isGlobal, IF(ISOMITTED(isGlobalCoor), TRUE, FALSE), MAP(Frames, LAMBDA(frameName, TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "Frame=" & frameName, "LoadPat=" & LoadPat, IF(isGlobal, "CoordSys=GLOBAL", "CoordSys=LOCAL"), "Type=Force", "Dir=" & Dir, "DistType=RelDist", "RelDistA=0", "RelDistB=1", "FOverLA=" & Value, "FOverLB=" & Value, )))))
comment: Create text regarding frame distributed load assignment definition data in SAP2000 $2k format. Last Update at 2024-07-11.
